theme_archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury / Dark) with Electric Tech Accents
concept: A cinematic, premium dark-mode experience that feels protective, highly intelligent, and exclusive. Avoids 'alarmist' red aesthetics in favor of commanding, reassuring deep purples and magenta glows.

splash.layout: Centered vertically and horizontally. Full screen absolute background glow.

sequence.action: Fade in with subtle glow behind

styling.title: h1 scale, text-transparent with linear gradient brand colors
styling.ai_desc: body_base scale, text.tertiary, max-width 80%, centered, italicized

intro_onboarding.layout: Flex column, space-between. Top: Logo + Neural Shield Graphic. Bottom: Value Prop + CTA.

elements.hero_image: Use the neural_shield media absolute or heavily sized at center-top with 50% opacity mask.
elements.title: H2, stark white. 'Your AI Safety Companion.'
elements.subtitle: Body_lg, secondary text. 'Proactive protection, anywhere in the world.'

cta_button.style: Full width, height 64px, pill shape (borderRadius: 32). Background linear gradient (Purple to Pink). Text white, H3 scale but bold.

language_selection.layout: Screen padding 24px. Header top-left. ScrollView for cards. Floating CTA at bottom.

elements.header: Logo icon scaled down top-left. H2 Title 'Select Language' below it. Subtitle 'You can change this anytime.'

card_item.style: Glassmorphism card specs. Height 80px. Flex row, align center, padding horizontal 24px. Left: Flag icon + Language Name. Right: Subdued Language Code (e.g., EN, ES).
card_item.selected_state: Border color becomes Primary Purple, subtle inner purple glow (box-shadow/elevation), text becomes white.

elements.bottom_cta: Absolute bottom, width 100%, padding 24px. Glassmorphism blur container behind it to prevent cutoff. 'Continue' button matches Intro CTA style.

logo.treatment: CRITICAL: Logo has a white background. Use React Native Image style with 'tintColor' to extract the mask, OR use a circular/shield-shaped MaskedView. If rendering fully, put it inside a glassmorphism pill so the white background looks intentional. Best approach for splash: render with 'overlay' or 'multiply' blend mode if possible, or crop tightly.

background_glow.description: Abstract fluid dark background with magenta and purple glows. Use absolute fill behind the Splash and Intro screens.

neural_shield.description: 3D neon purple shield nodes. Use as hero visual in Intro/Onboarding.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use expo-linear-gradient for all color gradients.
Use expo-blur for the glassmorphism effects. Ensure `tint="dark"` is used.
Animations must be implemented using React Native Reanimated or standard Animated API. Do not skip the staggered timing on the splash screen.
The UI must feel extremely premium. Adhere strictly to the Spacing tokens. Do not center everything on the language selection page (follow optical left alignment).
All interactive elements MUST have `testID` attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid).
Apply `SafeAreaView` so content does not bleed into the device notch or home indicator.
